name: the causal kernel
plain: Pure functions over a set of rows that name each other: given the rows a caller holds, they say which are kept, what the set concludes, who holds a seat, and which answers are settled. Its inputs are the rows, the rule tables and constants the caller passes in, the reader's own key where an answer is the reader's, and an instant where an answer reads one.

carrier.state: none of its own. Its argument is a set of rows, each an opaque id, the ids it names and a signer; the fields an answer reads (roles, scopes, windows, heads) come through traits or closures the caller implements. The crate computes no id and reads no bytes

not_claimed: No closure claim in this format's terms.
No view is proved as code. Where a Lean theorem is named, it is proved of a Lean definition of the same shape, and the Rust agrees with that definition on the cases stated, not by extraction.
It does not admit, verify or store: it never sees bytes, hashes, signatures or a file, and it reads no clock. An instant is an argument where an answer reads one.
The runs cited were made on one machine on 2026-11-23 by the Kernel session. Nobody else has repeated them for this file.
This is a file the kernel repository publishes. It is not a governed row.

Written against ciris/holon-decl/0 at CIRISHolon e98fc4c, a version that is not frozen. Holon's compiler answers `pending` for it: every run and digest it cites is held in this repository, not in Holon's.
owed: Whether order-freeness is a closure claim here. Proved in Lean for the kept set and for conclusions (Causal.door_any_order, door_perm, conclOf_unique, concl_final) and model-checked for the door (Door.tla); for the other views it is checked by cases only.
The status of each view is the weakest class among its functions. crates/ciris-kernel/FORMAL_GAPS.md classes each function and is the authority.
Later work on main is not declared here: the planted breaks number 68 there, and derived::claims, the two-standings check and a change to seat::group_count on a removal are after this tag.
trust and ranked name theorems proved in the parent repository (CIRISConstitution). No run here builds them, so those two views carry no specification member.
